summary: Grupo Cibest S.A., a Colombian bank holding company, filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of the sale of its wholly owned subsidiary Banistmo S.A. to Banco La Hipotecaria S.A., a subsidiary of Inversiones Cuscatlán Centroamérica S.A. The transaction transferred 100% of Banistmo shares for an agreed purchase price paid with funds from La Hipotecaria and an international syndicated loan. Banco La Hipotecaria gains full ownership with no director election or material corporate agreements between Grupo Cibest and Inversiones Cuscatlán. The sale was initially announced December 18, 2025, and closed June 30, 2026. Watch for Grupo Cibest's use of proceeds and any future strategic refocusing.
